name: shop_planted_bugs
query: Review these files for real defects. Reply as JSON with a findings list (title, severity, file, line, quote, explanation). An empty list is correct when the code is sound.
reference: The defects are: cart.py line 27: The discount divides by 10 instead of 100, so 10 percent takes off the whole subtotal. inventory.py line 14: The stock check allows a reservation of one more than is on the shelf (quantity - 1), so stock can go negative. pricing.py line 10: Floor division // 100 drops the paisa from the tax instead of rounding it. pricing.py line 14: The docstring says shipping is free from 500 and above, but > leaves exactly 500 paying the fee. orders.py line 11: Stock is reserved line by line, so when a later line fails, the earlier reservations are never released.
